system_identity.name: RoomsOnline (ROL)
system_identity.scope: PMS-agnostic booking engine that unifies multiple Property Management Systems under one interface
system_identity.primary_function: Orchestrate bookings across diverse PMS backends while providing consistent UI/UX
is_not: the source of truth for availability or rates

NO_BOOKING_FROM_CACHE.rule: Booking decisions MUST always verify with live PMS
NO_BOOKING_FROM_CACHE.reason: Cache is for display performance only, never for transactional decisions
NO_BOOKING_FROM_CACHE.enforcement: All booking flows call PMS adapter before confirmation

PMS_AUTHORITY.rule: External PMS is always authoritative for availability, rates, and booking confirmations
PMS_AUTHORITY.reason: ROL orchestrates, PMS decides inventory state
PMS_AUTHORITY.enforcement: No direct database updates to availability/rates without PMS sync

ADAPTER_PATTERN.rule: Each PMS has isolated edge function adapter
ADAPTER_PATTERN.reason: New PMS integration requires zero core UI changes

SNAKE_CASE.rule: All database fields, API responses, and code variables use snake_case
SNAKE_CASE.reason: Consistency across PostgreSQL, TypeScript, and API boundaries

RLS_MANDATORY.rule: Row Level Security on all tables
RLS_MANDATORY.reason: Data access control at database level

data_authority_model.cache_purpose: Performance optimization for display. Never authoritative for transactions.

critical_rules: NEVER bypass live PMS verification for bookings
NEVER modify adapter contracts without backward compatibility
NEVER expose PMS credentials or API keys in client code
NEVER allow booking from stale cache data
ALWAYS use service_role for administrative database operations
ALWAYS log sync operations to sync_logs table

admin_console.purpose: System administration, user management, PMS configuration

glossary.pms: Property Management System - external software that manages property inventory, rates, and reservations
glossary.adapter: Isolated edge function handling PMS-specific API communication, implementing standard contract
glossary.cache: Read-only copy of PMS data stored in ROL database for display performance
glossary.native_pms: ROL's built-in PMS functionality for properties without external PMS integration
glossary.sync_logs: Audit trail table recording all data synchronization between ROL and external PMS
glossary.rls: Row Level Security - PostgreSQL feature for fine-grained data access control
glossary.edge_function: Serverless function running on Supabase infrastructure for backend logic
glossary.booking_widget: Embeddable component for date/guest selection and availability checking
